item.title: Bioinformatics Scientist
item.description:
Leads automation of demultiplexing, quality control, gene expression analysis, and standardized data analysis using containerized workflows (Docker, Argo Workflows, Nextflow) deployed across Kubernetes, SLURM, and cloud infrastructure. Responsible for diagnosing and resolving complex sequencing and bioinformatics failures, optimizing pipeline performance, and ensuring analyses meet internal quality standards and customer requirements.

Acts as the primary Bioinformatics scientist interface between sequencing operations, wet-lab teams, and customers—translating experimental design and data quality constraints into robust, reproduciable bioinformatics outputs.

item.title: Bioinformatics Engineer (Contract)
item.description:
Project-based consulting role concurrent with full-time responsibilities, focusing on deep learning-based biomarker discovery for liver disease. Responsible for designing and implementing deep learning models for biomarker identification, integrating multi-modal data sources, and delivering reproducible analyses that support downstream modeling and research reporting.

Key Contributions & Impact

  • ML/DL Data Analysis: Conducted end-to-end analysis of bulk and single-cell RNA-seq datasets for liver disease cohorts, with heavy use of public resources such as NCBI GEO and ARCHS4. Led extensive data cleaning, normalization, gene filtering, and metadata harmonization across studies, producing reproducible analyses and clear, biologically interpretable summaries to support downstream modeling and research reporting.

item.title: Bioinformatician
item.description:
Conducted comprehensive genome-wide methylation analyses and developed pipelines for metagenomics and exome sequencing data analysis.

Key Achievements

  • Conducted comprehensive genome-wide methylation analyses using both ONT and Illumina platforms, enabling robust cross-platform comparisons in blood and mouth swab samples.
  • Designed and developed pipeline for metagenomics data analysis for environmental and clinical samples using data from both ONT and Illumina to compare results.
  • Implemented a custom in-house database using Kraken and Cerntifuge tailored to bacterial and fungal pathogens, facilitating rapid identification of over 200 clinically relevant species in metagenomic datasets.
  • Developed Snakemake pipelines for efficient workflow execution and scalability in the analysis of Whole exome sequencing data from ONT and Illumina platfrom.
  • Developed Variant Calling Pipeline for target enrichment long-read sequencing with adaptive sampling in exome sequencing data specifically targeting cardiac arrhythmia genes and Parkinson’s disease.

Technologies Used

Snakemake, ONT, Illumina, Python, R, Metagenomics tools, Variant calling tools

item.title: Bioinformatician
item.description:
Applied machine learning, statistical modeling, and bioinformatics to analyze multi-omics datasets for biomarker and target discovery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Applied machine learning, statistical modeling, and bioinformatics to analyze multi-omics datasets (TCGA, 1000 Genomes, GEO) for biomarker and target discovery.
  • Performed feature selection, clustering, and survival analysis to link gene expression patterns with clinical outcomes, presenting results through clear, data-driven visualizations.

Technologies Used

Python, R, Machine Learning, Statistical Modeling, TCGA, 1000 Genomes, GEO databases

item.title: Data Analyst
item.description:
Contributed to grant proposal writing and community health initiatives, focusing on breast cancer screening, Alzheimer’s awareness, and local health fairs. Analyzed community health data and developed data collection tools to support outreach programs.

Key Contributions & Impact

  • Grant Proposal Writing and Community Health Initiatives: Contributed to grant proposals writing and community health initiatives focused on breast cancer screening, Alzheimer’s awareness, and local health fairs.

  • Data Collection and Analysis: Analyzed community health data and built a JavaScript-based form to collect responses from 1,500+ participants, improving outreach effectiveness and data collection efficiency.

item.title: Quality Control Manager
item.description:
Managed quality control operations and ensured compliance with international quality standards. Responsible for implementing ISO 13485 quality management systems, reviewing standard operating procedures, and coordinating external audits to enhance QC procedures and regulatory compliance.

Key Contributions & Impact

  • ISO 13485 Implementation and GMP Compliance: Implemented ISO 13485 quality standards, reviewed 200+ SOPs, and optimized GMP compliance across operations.

  • External Audit Coordination: Coordinated and executed an ISO 13485 external audit, enhancing QC procedures for greater efficiency and regulatory compliance.

item.title: Research Assistant
item.description:
Supported preclinical research studies by maintaining test materials, documentation, and ensuring compliance with OECD GLP standards. Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams including pharmacologists, toxicologists, and veterinarians to facilitate preclinical study execution.

Key Contributions & Impact

  • Test Materials and Documentation Management: Maintained test materials and documentation for preclinical studies in compliance with OECD GLP standards.

  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Collaborated with pharmacologists, toxicologists, and veterinarians on preclinical studies, ensuring proper study execution and regulatory compliance.
